_doc: Story 4.4 GOLDEN FIXTURE — the OPTIONS / TILLVAL + hidden-row INCLUSION pin (4.4-GOLDEN-01, R-408). Pins the pure BASIS/inclusion rule the later calc surface must obey: an option (tillval) that is SELECTED (accepted with the base) COUNTS toward the eligible basis / section net / VAT totals; an option that is NOT selected does NOT count and is NEVER summed; a HIDDEN row DOES count toward the basis and totals (owner decision 2026-06-18, Epic 5.4/5.5). Epic 4 pins ONLY this pure INCLUSION rule — the UI visibility / selection semantics (how a row is toggled, how an option is presented) are Epic 5's (cross-ref R-408). The fixture is a LIVE oracle: the golden-pack test drives the frozen 4.1/4.2/4.3 `@/lib/money` primitives (`sumOre` for the included-basis sum, `lineVatOre` for the per-line VAT, `estimateDeduction` for the hidden-row deduction basis) against these pinned öre — a wrong inclusion decision fails LOUD. This REUSES the `rot-gron-deductions.json` hidden-row inclusion shape (`eligibleBasisLines`) as the model. Money/öre/rate numbers ONLY — NO PII (personnummer/orgnr/name/email/phone/address), NO clock (NFR17/R-411). The inclusion policy below is the CONSERVATIVE PILOT ASSUMPTION owner-decided 2026-06-18 (hidden rows + selected options count; unselected options excluded); it is recorded as a pilot assumption, NOT accounting/legally-final, and the underlying rates/caps stay the pending 4.3 UNAPPROVED placeholders. STOP (needs-human) if a DIFFERENT inclusion rule (e.g. options excluded from the deduction basis) must be treated as production-approved.

policy.selectedOption: an option/tillval ACCEPTED WITH THE BASE (selected) COUNTS toward the eligible basis / section net / VAT totals
policy.unselectedOption: an option/tillval NOT selected does NOT count and is NEVER summed into the basis/totals
policy.hiddenRow: a hidden row DOES count toward the basis and totals (owner decision 2026-06-18, Epic 5.4/5.5) — Epic 4 pins the pure BASIS rule, UI visibility is Epic 5
policy.basisSum: included lines sum via the Story 4.1 sumOre (sum-of-rounded); the deduction basis reuses the 4.3 estimateDeduction multi-line eligibleBasisLines path (hidden rows included)
policy.vatRounding: per-line VAT via the Story 4.2 lineVatOre (round each included line's VAT, then SUM the rounded values) — an excluded line contributes NO VAT
policy.scopeNote: Epic 4 pins the pure INCLUSION rule ONLY; the options/hidden-row VISIBILITY + selection UI is Epic 5 (R-408 cross-ref) — this fixture builds NO calc rows and NO UI

inclusionCases.note: A SELECTED option (accepted with the base) COUNTS toward the section net. Base lines [50000, 30000] öre + a SELECTED option 20000 öre -> included section net = sumOre([50000, 30000, 20000]) = 100000 öre. Owner decision 2026-06-18: an option accepted with base counts. The included set is the source of truth for the basis.

An UNSELECTED option does NOT count. Same base [50000, 30000] öre but the option 15000 öre is NOT selected -> included section net = sumOre([50000, 30000]) = 80000 öre; the unselected 15000 öre is NEVER summed. If the engine ever summed the unselected option, the net would be 95000 (the excludedWouldGive value) and this pin fails loud.

A SELECTED option counts toward the per-line-then-summed VAT total too. Included lines [50000, 30000, 20000] öre @ 2500 bp -> per-line VAT round(12500)=12500, round(7500)=7500, round(5000)=5000 -> section VAT = sumVatOre = 25000 öre (sum-of-rounded). The excluded 15000-öre option would have added round(3750)=3750 (NOT added).

A HIDDEN row DOES count toward the ROT eligible basis (owner decision 2026-06-18, hidden rows count). Multi-line basis [50000, 30000, 10000] where the 3rd line is HIDDEN -> eligibleBasis = sumOre = 90000 öre (hidden row INCLUDED); ROT deduction via estimateDeduction (ROT_PROFILE_UNAPPROVED, 3000 bp, private) = round(90000*3000/10000) = 27000 öre, well under the cap. Reuses the 4.3 estimateDeduction multi-line hidden-row path; UI visibility is Epic 5. requiresSignOff stays true (UNAPPROVED profile).
